title: EvidenceItem
description: One criterion-scoped piece of evidence produced by a verifier/prover/checker/human (spec §6.2). The atom of the evidence-authority model: it records WHAT was established (criterion_id), by WHOM (producer + implementation_hash), over WHAT scope + assumptions, with what LOGICAL vs EXECUTION status, and under which AUTHORITY class — so the deterministic reducer can decide precedence (§7.3) without trusting reviewer rhetoric. Authority applies ONLY to the recorded criterion, coverage, assumptions, and implication direction (§5.2 criterion-scoped-authority invariant): a unit test establishes observed behavior for its executed cases, not universal correctness; a sound counterexample conclusively disproves a property even when passing runs cannot prove it. Immutable + content-addressed; evidence accumulates until invalidated by a material artifact change (§10.1).

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version (semver). Optional on emission — stamped by the emission layer.

evidence_id.description: Unique id for this evidence item; referenced by ReviewDecision.evidence_refs and VerificationReport.

criterion_id.description: The single criterion this evidence bears on (keys into AssuranceProfile.criteria). Authority is scoped to this criterion — nothing else.

producer.description: What produced the evidence (a specific verifier/prover/checker/model/human), pinned by version + implementation hash so replay can rerun the exact producer.

version.description: Producer version — a change materially invalidates prior decisions (§12.3 verifier implementation/version).

implementation_hash.description: Content address of the producer implementation, so 'same version' cannot silently drift.

scope.description: What this evidence actually covered — the bound on its authority (§5.2/§7.3 rule 2). A reviewer may only override conclusive scoped evidence by showing assumptions or scope differ.

artifact_hash.description: Content address of the exact artifact the producer ran against.

coverage.description: What was exercised (modules, cases, branches, sources...).

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions under which the verdict holds.

status.description: The two-valued outcome (spec §7.2): do NOT collapse tool failure into epistemic uncertainty.

logical.description: Epistemic verdict. solver UNKNOWN -> unknown; counterexample -> fail; two sound producers disagree -> conflict.

execution.description: Operational health. A crash is logical=unknown/execution=error — never a proof of logical failure (§7.3 rule 5).

authority.description: The criterion-scoped authority this evidence carries (spec §7.1). Governs whether it may approve and/or block.

class.description: Authority class. proof/complete_decider approve+block; sound_refutation blocks only; sound_acceptance approves only; bounded_test/statistical_evidence policy-dependent; heuristic_static/llm_judgment normally neither (llm_judgment only after calibration + policy grant); human_attestation policy-dependent.

valid_for.description: Criterion_ids this authority is valid for. Absent/empty = the item's own criterion_id.

may_block.description: Whether a failing verdict here may block the decision.

may_approve.description: Whether a passing verdict here may approve the decision.

certificate.description: Machine-checkable witness backing the verdict (counterexample trace, unsat core, proof term, failing assertion, source-span). Content-addressed.

ref.description: Content address of the witness, e.g. 'blob:sha256:<hex>'.

payload.description: Inline witness content when small (else use ref).

provenance.description: Reproducibility record for the evidence run (spec §6.2).

environment_hash.description: Content address of the environment/dependency lockfile — a change invalidates prior decisions (§12.3).

command_hash.description: Content address of the exact command/invocation.
